description_en: Retrieves the connection credentials for a cloud desktop
name: GetConnectionTicket

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196646.html operation to query the regions supported by Elastic Desktop Service
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID。可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196646.html获取无影云电脑支持的地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The unique ID generated by the client
parameters.name: client_id

parameters.help_en: The session ID. You can call the GetLoginToken operation to obtain the session ID
parameters.name: session_id

parameters.help_en: The logon token. You can call the GetLoginToken operation to obtain the logon token
parameters.name: login_token

parameters.help_en: The ID of the cloud desktop connection task. You do not need to specify this parameter when you call this operation for the first time. For subsequent calls, set this parameter to the `TaskId` returned by the previous call
parameters.help_zh:
云电脑连接任务ID。     
首次调用本接口时无需配置，后续调用本接口时配置为上一次调用本接口返回的`TaskId`
parameters.name: task_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the cloud desktop
parameters.name: desktop_id

parameters.help_en: The operating system of the client
parameters.name: client_os

parameters.help_en:
This parameter allows you to configure a custom user-mode application. After the credentials are obtained, the application is automatically executed.

appPath: String type. The path to the application executable file. Example: `"C:\Program Files (x86)\000\000.exe"`. Note that you must use double backslashes () as path separators.
appParameter: String type. The startup parameters for the application. Example: `"meetingid 000 meetingname aaa"`. Note that parameters must be separated by spaces
parameters.help_zh:
当前参数可以配置自定义用户态应用，当成功获取凭证后，自动执行应用。

appPath：String类型，应用启动文件路径，例如：`"C:\\Program Files (x86)\\000\\000.exe"`，注意路径分隔符要用双斜杠（\\）。
appParameter：String类型，应用启动参数，例如：`"meetingid 000 meetingname aaa"`，注意参数与参数之间直接用空格
parameters.name: command_content

parameters.help_en: The unique identifier of the client. If you use the Wuying client, you can view this parameter in the About dialog box on the client logon page
parameters.help_zh: 客户端唯一标识。若使用无影客户端，可在客户端登录界面的关于对话框中查看该参数
parameters.name: uuid

fields.help_en: The tag key. If you specify `Tag`, `Key` is required. The tag key can be up to 128 characters in length. It cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`, contain `http://` or `https://`, or contain only spaces
fields.help_zh: 标签键。如果传入`Tag`，则`Key`是必填的。不可超过128个字符，不能以`aliyun`或`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`，也不能仅包含空格
fields.name: key

fields.help_en: The tag value. The tag value can be an empty string. It can be up to 128 characters in length. It cannot start with `acs:` or contain `http://` or `https://`
fields.help_zh: 标签值。可以为空字符串。最多支持128个字符，不能以`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`
fields.name: value

parameters.help_en: The list of tags. You can specify 1 to 20 tags
parameters.name: tag

TaskCode.description_en:
The ticket used to connect to the user instance. Before you use the ticket, you must decode its content by using Base64, save the decoded content as an .ica file (for example, xxx.ica), and then open the file. Python code example:

```
import base64
response = {
    "Ticket": "W0VuY29kaW5nXQ0KSW5wdXRFbmNvZGluZz1V********",
    "RequestId": "1CBAFFAB-B697-4049-A9B1-67E1FC5F****",
}
f = open ('xxx.ica', 'w')
out = base64.b64decode(response['Ticket'])
f.write(out)
f.close()
```

```
out = base64.b64decode(response['Ticket'])
f.write(out)
f.close()
```
